//@version=6
indicator("Ultimate RSI", "Ultimate RSI", max_lines_count = 500, max_labels_count = 500)
//------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//Settings
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------{
length = input.int(14, minval = 2, tooltip = "Lookback length used to calculate the Ultimate RSI.")
smoType1 = input.string('RMA', 'Method', options = ['EMA', 'SMA', 'RMA', 'TMA'], tooltip = "Smoothing method used for the Ultimate RSI.")
src = input.source(close, 'Source', tooltip = "Source used to calculate the Ultimate RSI.")

arsiCss = input.color(color.silver, 'Color', inline = 'rsicss', group = 'Style')
autoCss = input.bool(true, 'Auto', inline = 'rsicss', group = 'Style', tooltip = "Automatically color the RSI by its overbought and oversold state.")

//Signal Line
smooth = input.int(14, minval = 1, group = 'Signal Line', tooltip = "Length used to smooth the signal line.")
smoType2 = input.string('EMA', 'Method', options = ['EMA', 'SMA', 'RMA', 'TMA'], group = 'Signal Line', tooltip = "Smoothing method used for the signal line.")

signalCss = input.color(#ff5d00, 'Color', group = 'Signal Line', tooltip = "Color of the signal line.")

//OB/OS Style
obValue = input.float(80, 'Overbought', inline = 'ob', group = 'OB/OS Style', tooltip = "Upper level used to identify overbought conditions.")
obCss = input.color(#089981, '', inline = 'ob', group = 'OB/OS Style', tooltip = "Overbought level color.")
obAreaCss = input.color(color.new(#089981, 80), '', inline = 'ob', group = 'OB/OS Style', tooltip = "Overbought area color.")

osValue = input.float(20, 'Oversold    ', inline = 'os', group = 'OB/OS Style', tooltip = "Lower level used to identify oversold conditions.")
osCss = input.color(#f23645, '', inline = 'os', group = 'OB/OS Style', tooltip = "Oversold level color.")
osAreaCss = input.color(color.new(#f23645, 80), '', inline = 'os', group = 'OB/OS Style', tooltip = "Oversold area color.")

//Divergence Settings
showDivergences = input.bool(true, 'Show Regular Divergences', group = 'Divergence', tooltip = "Draw confirmed regular bullish and bearish divergences on the Ultimate RSI.")
showHiddenDivergences = input.bool(false, 'Show Hidden Divergences', group = 'Divergence', tooltip = "Draw confirmed hidden bullish and bearish divergences on the Ultimate RSI.")
pivotLeftInput = input.int(5, 'Pivot Left', minval = 1, group = 'Divergence', tooltip = "Number of bars to the left used to confirm an oscillator pivot.")
pivotRightInput = input.int(5, 'Pivot Right', minval = 1, group = 'Divergence', tooltip = "Number of bars to the right required to confirm an oscillator pivot.")
bullishDivCss = input.color(#089981, 'Bullish Color', group = 'Divergence', tooltip = "Color used for bullish divergence lines and labels.")
bearishDivCss = input.color(#f23645, 'Bearish Color', group = 'Divergence', tooltip = "Color used for bearish divergence lines and labels.")
hiddenBullishDivCss = input.color(color.new(#089981, 35), 'Hidden Bullish Color', group = 'Divergence', tooltip = "Color used for hidden bullish divergence lines and labels.")
hiddenBearishDivCss = input.color(color.new(#f23645, 35), 'Hidden Bearish Color', group = 'Divergence', tooltip = "Color used for hidden bearish divergence lines and labels.")

//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------}
//Functions
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------{
ma(x, len, maType)=>
    switch maType
        'EMA' => ta.ema(x, len)
        'SMA' => ta.sma(x, len) 
        'RMA' => ta.rma(x, len) 
        'TMA' => ta.sma(ta.sma(x, len), len)
 
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------}
//Augmented RSI
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------{
upper = ta.highest(src, length)
lower = ta.lowest(src, length)
r = upper - lower

d = src - src[1]
diff = upper > upper[1] ? r 
  : lower < lower[1] ? -r 
  : d

num = ma(diff, length, smoType1)
den = ma(math.abs(diff), length, smoType1)
arsi = num / den * 50 + 50

signal = ma(arsi, smooth, smoType2)

//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------}
//Divergence Detection
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------{
pivotLow = ta.pivotlow(arsi, pivotLeftInput, pivotRightInput)
pivotHigh = ta.pivothigh(arsi, pivotLeftInput, pivotRightInput)

var int previousLowBar = na
var float previousLowPrice = na
var float previousLowArsi = na
var int previousHighBar = na
var float previousHighPrice = na
var float previousHighArsi = na

newPivotLow = barstate.isconfirmed and not na(pivotLow)
newPivotHigh = barstate.isconfirmed and not na(pivotHigh)

if newPivotLow
    currentLowBar = bar_index - pivotRightInput
    currentLowPrice = low[pivotRightInput]
    currentLowArsi = arsi[pivotRightInput]

    regularBullish = not na(previousLowBar) and currentLowPrice < previousLowPrice and currentLowArsi > previousLowArsi
    hiddenBullish = not na(previousLowBar) and currentLowPrice > previousLowPrice and currentLowArsi < previousLowArsi

    if showDivergences and regularBullish
        line.new(previousLowBar, previousLowArsi, currentLowBar, currentLowArsi, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = bullishDivCss, width = 2)
        label.new(currentLowBar, currentLowArsi, 'Bull', xloc = xloc.bar_index, style = label.style_label_up, color = bullishDivCss, textcolor = color.white, size = size.tiny)

    if showHiddenDivergences and hiddenBullish
        line.new(previousLowBar, previousLowArsi, currentLowBar, currentLowArsi, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = hiddenBullishDivCss, width = 2, style = line.style_dashed)
        label.new(currentLowBar, currentLowArsi, 'Hidden Bull', xloc = xloc.bar_index, style = label.style_label_up, color = hiddenBullishDivCss, textcolor = color.white, size = size.tiny)

    previousLowBar := currentLowBar
    previousLowPrice := currentLowPrice
    previousLowArsi := currentLowArsi

if newPivotHigh
    currentHighBar = bar_index - pivotRightInput
    currentHighPrice = high[pivotRightInput]
    currentHighArsi = arsi[pivotRightInput]

    regularBearish = not na(previousHighBar) and currentHighPrice > previousHighPrice and currentHighArsi < previousHighArsi
    hiddenBearish = not na(previousHighBar) and currentHighPrice < previousHighPrice and currentHighArsi > previousHighArsi

    if showDivergences and regularBearish
        line.new(previousHighBar, previousHighArsi, currentHighBar, currentHighArsi, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = bearishDivCss, width = 2)
        label.new(currentHighBar, currentHighArsi, 'Bear', xloc = xloc.bar_index, style = label.style_label_down, color = bearishDivCss, textcolor = color.white, size = size.tiny)

    if showHiddenDivergences and hiddenBearish
        line.new(previousHighBar, previousHighArsi, currentHighBar, currentHighArsi, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = hiddenBearishDivCss, width = 2, style = line.style_dashed)
        label.new(currentHighBar, currentHighArsi, 'Hidden Bear', xloc = xloc.bar_index, style = label.style_label_down, color = hiddenBearishDivCss, textcolor = color.white, size = size.tiny)

    previousHighBar := currentHighBar
    previousHighPrice := currentHighPrice
    previousHighArsi := currentHighArsi

//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------}
//Plots
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------{
plot_rsi = plot(arsi, 'Ultimate RSI'
  , arsi > obValue ? obCss
  : arsi < osValue ? osCss 
  : autoCss ? chart.fg_color : arsiCss)

plot(signal, 'Signal Line', signalCss)

//Levels
plot_up = plot(obValue, color = na, editable = false)
plot_avg = plot(50, color = na, editable = false)
plot_dn = plot(osValue, color = na, editable = false)

//OB-OS
fill(plot_rsi, plot_up, arsi > obValue ? obAreaCss : na)
fill(plot_dn, plot_rsi, arsi < osValue ? osAreaCss : na)

//Gradient
fill(plot_rsi, plot_avg, obValue, 50, obAreaCss, color.new(chart.bg_color, 100))
fill(plot_avg, plot_rsi, 50, osValue, color.new(chart.bg_color, 100), osAreaCss)

hline(obValue, 'Overbought')
hline(50, 'Midline')
hline(osValue, 'Oversold')

//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------}
